name: Human Postures Recognition Benchmark
description: A benchmarking and performance evaluation suite measuring accelerometer-based human posture recognition accuracy and runtime on embedded platforms.
reputation: Niche benchmark used in embedded/wearable-sensor research; modest adoption in the community.
notes: Small dataset and device-specific runtime measurements make cross-hardware comparisons difficult; non-LLM benchmark; real-time constraints and class imbalance can affect reported metrics.
